notes.title: HAPPY 1 YEAR SINCE LAUNCH! (Future plans)
notes.notes:
Happy 1 year anniversary everyone! What a blast it has been, we wanted to take this opportunity to thank everyone for all the support and warmth we have been receiving from this little game. To be absolutely honest, when we made it, we didn't really know what we were doing and so we were very surprised that so many people enjoyed it!

As a year has passed, we haven't been just sitting around but actually, we have been working on something that we think is pretty special!

The project is still in very early preproduction, with limitless possibilities! And we'd like you to take part in this as if we are building the game together!

Check this out!
[previewyoutube=wxHE1laxKWg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Winning Audience Award thanks to YOU!
notes.notes:
[h1]We honestly have no words[/h1]

Thank you all so much for voting and believing in our little project. We can't believe there were so many people who believed in us. We hope that as time passes, as we learn more, and as we grow together, we can make better games for you all to enjoy.

I love my community and I am really grateful to have made weekly / monthly updates on the game whether it is youtube or Twitter and to see and chat with everyone, there really is a connection that I feel and I would not trade it for anything else. 

The game wouldn't be where it is right now if it wasn't thanks to you.

[h1]Regarding our Future Plans[/h1]

Although we are very keen on further improving Tadpole Tales or even turning it into a bigger proper game with more bosses and stories. We have got an urge to make a platformer game! 

It will still be a relatively small game as we are still very new to game development but I am very excited to share with you all of our processes once we finish our Pre-Production Phase.

[h1]Follow the Development[/h1]
Once we enter the Production Phase, I will be a lot more vocal with our development. level design, contents, and story so you guys can all tag along with me and it will feel as if we are all making a game together! ([i]Just like Tadpole Tales[/i]) 
[url=https://youtu.be/ZFN5QGLm3-A]Youtube Link[/url]

[h1]Get Notified on Launch! [/h1]
If you just wish to get notified when our next game comes out you can simply sign up on [url=https://pinnicalstudio.com/our-next-project]Our MailingList[/url]. The confirmation E-mail also sends you a few drawings of the [u]Concept Art[/u] for our next game.




[h3]Thank you again! You are all gems <3
Andrew[/h3]

notes.title: Nominated for UnfoldGames Award!
notes.notes:
[h1]We got nominated![/h1]
We have been nominated for the [b]Best Character Design Award[/b] and [b]Audience Award[/b] at UnfoldGames Awards. 

We’ve got no words to describe our happiness, as this is our first game as well as our first steps into game development and industry… we will try our very hardest to make our next game better than this one. The amount of support you guys showed us has become one of our core motivations to keep doing what we do. Which is making games that come from the heart. 

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
So, thank you again for being part of this journey with us and we cannot wait to show you what’s next to come! 

[h3][b][url=https://unfoldgamesawards.com/index.php?p=view&category=11&id=695]Vote By Clicking on the little Tadpole![/url][/b][/h3]
